spec.name: Brutalist Housing Block
spec.description: A slab-style raw concrete housing block with a stepped, cantilevered facade of deep balconies, a pilotis podium, a stair and lift core tower, and a roof terrace with plant.
spec.layout: A long east-west slab, about 30 m wide (x) and 12 m deep (z), 22 m high, standing on y = 0. The ground level is an open pilotis podium of chunky board-marked concrete columns with a recessed glazed lobby. Above it, five residential storeys of 3 m each, with deep egg-crate balcony boxes on the front (+Z) facade, staggered so the silhouette reads as stepped. A taller windowless stair and lift core tower rises at the left end (+X) to 22 m with slit windows. The roof carries a plant room box, a parapet and chimney-like vents. Every surface is flat grey concrete in a few tones, with darker recessed window and balcony voids, thin board-marked seams as small dark strips, rusty steel rails, and a few warm lit windows. No ground, trees or props beyond the block.

parts.builds: Ground level pilotis: 14 chunky square concrete columns in two rows with board-marked seam strips, a thick transfer slab on top (podiumTop), a recessed glazed lobby with a red door, a concrete canopy, entrance steps and a ramp in lighter slab colour, and stained dark bands at column feet.
parts.attaches: Top face at podiumTop supports the residential slab; the core base at coreBase stands beside the podium and shares its x edge.

parts.builds: The main residential volume from y 4.5 to 19.5: a concrete box 24 m wide, 8 m deep, five storeys with dark void window bands, glass panes, scattered warm lit windows, horizontal floor-edge seams, vertical board-marked seam strips, a back facade with small windows and access-deck walkways with rust railings, and end walls with weathering stains.
parts.attaches: Sits on podiumTop. Its front face slabFrontFace receives the balconies. Its right end meets the core tower. Roof at roofDeck.

parts.builds: The egg-crate front facade: staggered deep concrete balcony boxes projecting from z 4 to 6 on the slab front, each with a dark inner void, a thick concrete frame, a rust steel rail, a slab floor, and occasional potted moss plants, plus fins between bays and a deeper cantilevered block at the top two storeys giving a stepped profile.
parts.attaches: Back sits flush on slabFrontFace; the lowest row starts at podiumTop.

parts.builds: The stair and lift tower: a tall 8 by 10 m windowless concrete shaft from the floor to 22 m at coreBase, with narrow vertical slit windows glowing warmly, board-marked seams, a heavy overhanging cap slab at coreRoof, a projecting vertical stair fin, bridge walkways linking to the slab, a rust steel door at ground, and dark stain streaks.
parts.attaches: Stands at coreBase beside the podium and slab; the walkway bridges touch the slab end at x 10.

parts.builds: Roof terrace at roofDeck: thick parapet ring, a plant room box with louvres and a steel door, three chunky ventilation chimneys, water tank cylinder on legs, skylight boxes, rust ladders, moss patches, and drainage spouts jutting from the parapet.
parts.attaches: Rests on top of slabBody at roofDeck; adjacent to the core cap at coreRoof.
